reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 17 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution note and right-edge crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The returned upper note row is a regular series of four round dots rather than the source's irregular compact gray-mark groups. Restore the source-like irregular upper-mark footprint without substituting uniform dots.

The source's small dark right-edge tab is not retained as a distinct small tab at its source position and scale; the return shows only torn/notched paper contours. Restore that original small right-edge tab without adding a clip.
entries.positive_observation: Thick dark black-brown swept-back hair with a full hairline and short dark sideburns remains, together with thick dark brows and round dark spectacles. The face has one serious closed mouth and a smooth clean-shaven chin without a moustache or beard. The three-quarter viewer-left pose and leftward gaze remain. The light gray-beige jacket/tunic retains a narrow stand collar and one dark central button/closure without a necktie or added decorations. The rounded lower head meets a short broad collar transition. The complete thin dark frame and opaque dark blue-charcoal backplate remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The regular-dot note substitution and missing distinct small right-edge tab are the separate rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine spectacle-rim detail, the exact central collar closure and note glyphs are very small at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those details; the uniform-dot pattern and missing distinct small tab are clearly visible in native crops.
